visibleTestCases.title: Benchmark 2,000 BEAM Processes
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin #{spawned := S, avg_memory_bytes := M} = process_bench:run_bench(2000), {S, M < 4096} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies that 2,000 processes spawn in microseconds with an average memory footprint strictly under 4,096 bytes.
